direction: Refine the ruin priority hook `score_ruin_nodes` into a stagnation-adaptive, dimensionless multiplicative gate: rank-power of the scale-normalized removal savings with exponent p(iter_frac, stagnation_ratio) that shifts from exploitation (high p, worst-cost removal) toward diversification (p→1 + randomized-deterministic geometric spread) as stagnation rises; multiply by smooth gates for route load slack (dense/loose-capacity routes first), depot proximity asymmetry (eccentric-depot instances), and within-route distance, so that clustered/loose-capacity regimes get larger ruin sets while eccentric-depot routes are ruined along their far-side arc.

operations.mechanism: Archive shows a monotone 2-round improvement (16.1603 -> 16.0293, VBS gap only 0.052%) with all 5 weakest regimes clustered at the same instances, i.e. the remaining loss is regime-structured rather than random. KB entry method-cvrp-m3-ruin-recreate-l3 documents that the single evolvable hook score_ruin_nodes with fixed deterministic Regret-2 reinsertion + intra_2opt + R2R acceptance is the correct attribution-safe surface, and that a multiplicative gate x rank-power form p(iter_frac, stagnation_ratio) was exactly the rule that beat the L2a champion across interfaces (8/24 head-to-head). Keeping postprocess_mode=none preserves the 5-gate interface contract and the ~155 ms mean solve time at 2000 ms budget leaves ample LNS iteration headroom, so effort is best spent on diversity-controlling ruin scoring rather than on postprocessing.

preserve: Route feasibility, strict time budget, and scale invariance.
hypothesis: An evolved multiplicative-gate rank-power ruin score that is jointly normalized by the global depot-distance scale and adapts its rank exponent to stagnation will improve mean objective on cvrp_dev_hetero_24 versus the round-2 incumbent (16.0293), with the gains concentrated in the weakest regimes identified in the archive feedback (spatial=clustered, capacity_level=loose, size=100, depot_style=eccentric), because worst-cost removal alone over-focuses on long edges and never diversifies across routes of an eccentric-depot instance.
